images.title: 3 kg 600 g plus 2 kg 700 g in a column
images.purpose: Show how to add weights in a kg and g column: the g column makes 1,300 g, 1,000 g is exchanged for 1 kg and carried, and the answer is 6 kg 300 g.
images.composition: A two column sum with the carry of 1 kg above the kg column and two note boxes at the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. COLUMN HEADS at y 130: the unit kg (44 px, bold, teal #0072B2) centred at x 420 and the unit g (44 px, bold, amber-dark #E69F00) centred at x 720. ROW 1 at y 280: 3 centred at x 420 and 600 centred at x 720 (64 px, bold, dark #1F2937). ROW 2 at y 380: the sign + at x 280, then 2 centred at x 420 and 700 centred at x 720 (64 px, bold, dark #1F2937). RULE LINE: a dark #1F2937 horizontal line 4 px thick at y 440 from x 220 to x 920. RESULT ROW at y 530: 6 centred at x 420 and 300 centred at x 720 (64 px, bold, teal #0072B2). CARRY: a small circle 48 px across with a 3 px outline #CC79A7 and the digit 1 (36 px, bold) at (420, 255), above the kg column, with a thin dashed #CC79A7 curved arrow 3 px thick from the 1,300 note to the circle. NOTE BOX at the right, a rounded rectangle 440 by 130 px at x 960 to 1400, y 260 to 390, filled #F3F4F6 with a 3 px outline #6B7280, containing the text 600 + 700 = 1,300 g (40 px, bold, dark #1F2937). Under it a second box a rounded rectangle 440 by 100 px at x 960 to 1400, y 410 to 510, filled #F3F4F6 with a 3 px outline #6B7280, containing the text 1,000 g = 1 kg (40 px, bold, dark #1F2937).
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any digit other than those listed in the sum, or a carry that is not 1
the result row showing anything other than 6 kg and 300 g
images.takeaway: When the g column reaches 1,000 g or more, exchange 1,000 g for 1 kg and carry it: 3 kg 600 g + 2 kg 700 g = 6 kg 300 g.
images.description: A column sum of 3 kg 600 g and 2 kg 700 g with a carry of 1 kg and the result 6 kg 300 g.
images.context: Concept image for Adding Weights. It follows the idea of the kg and g column with a carry in your maths book and shows the concept's own example (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Add the g column first and say what 1,300 g is. The slip to watch: leaving 1,300 g in the g column.

image_decisions.why: The carry circle shows the exchange of 1,000 g for 1 kg.
